==Biography==
MiSTakE's first game was Lineage, at age five. When he was older he moved on to play other online games like DoTA and World of Warcraft. His first pro gaming experience was as a professional WoW player.His WoW toon was also named Mistake - as inspired by the song "Beautiful Mistake".<ref>[http://www.ttfun.com.tw/DOC/news_page?type=1&id=1627&tb=1 《TPA台北暗殺星》最厲害的指揮官　Mistake隊長專訪　全心為電競付出的熱血男人！ (Taiwanese)] ''www.ttfun.com.tw'' </ref>
